title: SRE, Platform & DevOps opportunities
lede: Latest RemoteOK inventory validated for target-family scope and Canadian regional eligibility. Scores measure technical fit only.
latest_update: Rechecked September 21, 2026 - no eligible target-family role found.

ineligible.title: Engineering Manager/TLM, Platform
ineligible.reason: Requires relocation to San Francisco and five days per week in office.

notes_sections.heading: Scope exclusions
items: Four other keyword hits were application-development roles whose descriptions merely mentioned infrastructure, DevOps or platform concepts; they were not target-family jobs.
No eligible or unresolved Canadian target-family posting appeared in the latest 99-job API inventory.

notes_sections.heading: Search limitations
items: The API is a latest-inventory feed rather than a dedicated semantic search. The latest 100-object boundary was reviewed by title, tags and full description.
No CAPTCHA, authentication or write-side action occurred.

method: The RemoteOK public API was fetched once. Its metadata object was discarded, the latest 99 jobs were screened, and plausible matches were gated using both location and description text.
